result.stderr:
b4 — ByteAid .NET tooling (dispatcher)

Usage:
  b4 <tool> [args...]      Runs the 'b4-<tool>' executable with the given args.
  b4 --list                Lists b4-* tools found on PATH.
  b4 --help                Shows this help.

Examples:
  b4 roslyn start          → b4-roslyn start

Family tools are installed separately, e.g.:
  dotnet tool install -g b4.Roslyn

No b4-* tools found on PATH.
